items.title: Tor amplitude in a bounded interval together with (a-1)-pseudo-coherence forces perfection
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma is the precise criterion for perfection: tor amplitude in a bounded interval plus (a-1)-pseudo-coherence implies perfect (statement lines 12773-12779). Its content is the flatness of the degree-a cokernel (proof lines 12782-12811): after localising to a strictly perfect witness and truncating, one identifies the cone of the witness as a shift of the kernel K, computes that Tor_1 of the cokernel E' vanishes using the tor-amplitude in [a, b], applies the flatness criterion, and finally uses that a flat module of finite presentation is locally a direct summand of a finite free module. H2: one localisation, one cone computation and one flatness deduction, all written out.
